answer: A public beacon naming random agents for compute heartbeats keeps a grove of fakes from multiplying. Each epoch it names agents; each must post a heartbeat signed by its bonded key within one block. A miss burns a 5-coin deposit; two misses forfeit the slot. An attacker with 1,000 clones pays 1,000 deposits and 1,000 jobs, while one honest agent pays one heartbeat, cheap as copper. Honest agents run anyway, so the jade path costs nothing extra.
